rounds.challenge_neighborhood: mechanistic world models + M-open discovery + verified representation revision

primary_sources.locator: Posner, Lei & Schölkopf, Mechanistic World Models and the Quest for Autonomous Discovery, arXiv:2607.12474
primary_sources.pressure: Mechanistic prediction/search is not identical to discovery; representation/mechanism structure is a direct parent and motivates a fixed-representation world-model comparator.
M-open proposal plus Bayesian inference/value-of-information can expand model structure without necessarily changing representation type; it remains a same-representation strong parent family.

primary_sources.locator: Wang & Buehler, Self-Revising Discovery Systems for Science, arXiv:2606.01444
primary_sources.pressure: Verified representational-regime revision with provenance/preservation is the strongest structural parent and must receive the same move and verification budget as ORION.

rounds.challenge_neighborhood: analogy + scientific divergence/negation + fixed-regime discovery control

primary_sources.locator: Shen, Druckmann & Zou, Unlocking LLM Creativity in Science through Analogical Reasoning, arXiv:2605.11258
primary_sources.pressure: Cross-domain analogical generation is a direct bridge/correspondence proposal parent but does not replace correspondence/protected validation gates.

primary_sources.locator: Bao et al., Contemporary AI lacks the imagination to diverge or negate in science, arXiv:2606.08251
primary_sources.pressure: Open-ended idea generation and automated interestingness/evaluation remain weak evidence for validated regime invention; protected structural verification remains necessary.

primary_sources.locator: Ota, Osa & Harada, Self-Supervised Theorem Discovery in a Formal Axiomatic System, arXiv:2606.28747
primary_sources.pressure: Important new results can be discovered inside a fixed axiom/operator regime, reinforcing the SEARCH_HARD_BUT_EXPRESSIBLE no-Jump control.

reopen_rule: A later donor that changes the strongest matched comparator, finite old-language insufficiency discriminator, representation move budget, correspondence requirement, or protected validation gate reopens the protocol and invalidates both saturation rounds.
